sehemu: Part II: Members of Parliament, Constituencies and Election of Members
jina: Formal declaration by Members concerning ethics of leaders
maudhui: (1) Every Member of Parliament shall, before the expiration of thirty days from the date on which he takes the oath of office as a Member, submit to the Speaker two copies of a formal declaration that he has not lost the qualifications for election in accordance with paragraph (d) of subarticle (2) of Article 67. (2) The formal declaration required to be submitted to the Speaker shall be made in the prescribed form provided for by a law enacted by Parliament. (3) The Speaker shall submit to the Ethics Commissioner one copy of every formal declaration submitted to him. (4) In this Article and in Articles 70 and 84, "Ethics Commissioner" means the Commissioner appointed to head the Ethics Secretariat referred to in Article 132 of this Constitution.
